lead: A comprehensive overview of current climate challenges and innovations, highlighting the interconnectedness of climate change, technological advancements, and existential threats.

stories.title: How the 2026 Super El Niño and Climate Change Are Related
stories.summary: The upcoming Super El Niño is expected to have significant impacts on global weather patterns, exacerbated by the ongoing climate crisis. Scientists are investigating how this record-setting phenomenon will interact with a planet that is already experiencing unprecedented heat. The article discusses the implications of these changes and the urgent questions researchers are seeking to answer.

stories.title: California’s Tallest and Most Iconic Trees Are Getting Heatstroke
stories.summary: Redwoods, which have adapted to cool, foggy climates, are now showing signs of distress as temperatures rise. A new study reveals that these iconic trees are slowing down photosynthesis in response to increased heat, raising concerns about their survival and the broader impacts on California's ecosystems.

stories.title: Nuclear war and malicious use of AI threaten end of humanity by 2100, says Lancet assessment
stories.summary: A new global risk assessment identifies climate change as one of 17 catastrophic threats to human health that could lead to extinction by 2100. The report emphasizes the urgent need for action to mitigate these risks, including the climate crisis, which is highlighted alongside threats from AI and nuclear conflict.

stories.title: Fixated on AI, the world has forgotten what is staring it in the face: nuclear annihilation
stories.summary: This commentary reflects on the overshadowing threat of nuclear weapons amidst the global focus on AI. It draws parallels between historical apocalyptic fears and current existential risks, including climate change, suggesting that humanity's neglect of these issues could lead to catastrophic outcomes.

stories.title: Why we’re watching these climate tech companies
stories.summary: MIT Technology Review has released its annual list of promising climate tech companies, showcasing innovations aimed at addressing climate change. The article highlights several firms that are making strides in energy technology, emphasizing the importance of these advancements in combatting the climate crisis.
